|notes=The remastered slip for Close Call uses the official text dated 4 December 2006. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Close Call (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Close Call (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions use the Used mode to cancel and redraw a just-drawn destiny during battle. The Lost mode reduces a just-drawn weapon or battle destiny by 3.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 30. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
